sources.entry: Floom - AI gateway and marketplace for developers, enables streamlined integration of AI features into products. #opensource

summary.one_liner: Floom is an open-source tool that orchestrates and executes Generative AI pipelines for developers, described as an AI gateway and marketplace.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short and gives little technical detail. It states that Floom orchestrates and executes Generative AI pipelines so developers can focus on their own work. It says the project is open source and free for everyone, including commercial use. The README points to a separate Documentation resource for getting started. The listing metadata describes it as an AI gateway and marketplace that helps integrate AI features into products. No specific features, APIs, or supported models are named in the README.
use_cases: adding AI features to a product
executing AI workflows as a developer
using a free open-source AI gateway
commercial AI integration without licensing fees
how_to_run: See the project's Documentation (linked from the README; URL not given in the README text)
notable: Open source and stated to be free for everyone, including commercial use
Positioned as an AI gateway and marketplace for developers (per listing metadata)
Focuses on orchestrating and executing Generative AI pipelines
caveats: README is very brief; technical details, supported models, and setup steps are not given in it
Installation and run instructions are only available through external documentation not included in the README
